title: RBI to continue efforts to curb rupee volatility; external factors driving currency fall: FM - The Economic Times
text:
Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman mentioned the Reserve Bank of India’s ongoing efforts to stabilize the rupee's value. She noted that the rupee has significantly depreciated due to global uncertainties, despite India's strong economic fundamentals. Sitharaman highlighted recent measures by the RBI that helped the rupee appreciate temporarily in value. She also acknowledged the healthy debate around tax rationalization in the securities market.
